plaatsen.tekst: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover
My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover
